issues.description: The template Lecture class declares some attributes as public (lectureName, numberOfInscribedStudents) while the problem UML shows these attributes as private and the solution uses private fields for all attributes. This visibility mismatch can confuse students about the intended encapsulation (private fields with getters/setters) and may lead them to implement inconsistent access patterns.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the template Lecture class fields private and include all attributes from the UML (lectureName, numberOfInscribedStudents, numberOfGuestStudents, numberOfLecturers, numberOfTutors) so the template's visibility matches the UML and the solution. This aligns the template with the intended encapsulation teaching goal (private attributes with public getters/setters).
